Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
          definition:
          obs:Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u | u.SuspensionDays > 0)
            
            precondition:
          obs->notEmpty()
            
            postcondition:
          obs->forAll(o:User| o.SuspensionDays = o.SuspensionDays - 1 and (o.SuspensionDays <= 0 implies o.BorrowStatus = REMODEL::BorrowStatus::SUSPEND))
            
        }
